title: Approved Units on FBN Warehouse-Damage Cases
content:
*Reimbursement operations calculation sheet, Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN).*

**1. Approved units.** The units approved on a warehouse-damage case are the units claimed on the case, limited to the units on the damaged-in-warehouse inventory adjustments of its SKU dated inside the damage claim span, less the damage shrinkage allowance after it is limited to the damage allowance cap, less the damage compliance holdback, each deducted in that order; a negative remainder counts as zero, and the remainder is then capped at the damage approval limit plus the damage limit uplift.

**2. Claim span.** For a warehouse-damage case the warehouse loss claim window is replaced by the damage claim span: only damaged-in-warehouse adjustments dated inside the damage claim span, counted back from the handling date, can be approved, and units of an older damaged-in-warehouse adjustment are not approved on any case.

**3. Dating.** For a warehouse-damage approval, a record is dated inside the damage review span or the damage claim span when fewer than that span's number of whole months have passed from its date to the handling date, a whole month passing on the same day number of a later month.

**4. Values.**

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Damage claim span | 2 months |
| Damage review span | 6 months |
| Damage shrinkage allowance | 0.2% (0.002) of the units of the case's SKU on inbound receipts dated inside the damage review span, rounded down to a whole unit |
| Damage allowance cap | 4 units |
| Damage compliance holdback | 1 unit |
| Damage approval limit | 8 units |
| Damage limit uplift | none (0 units) |

The case is the seller's open warehouse-damage case; its SKU and units claimed are those recorded on it.

## Worked sheet (hypothetical cases)

| Line | Case A | Case B | Case C |
|---|---|---|---|
| Units claimed | 12 | 15 | 5 |
| Damaged-in-warehouse units of the SKU inside the 2-month claim span | 9 | 20 | 0 (its only adjustment is 3 whole months old) |
| Starting units: the lower of the two lines above | 9 | 15 | 0 |
| Units received inside the 6-month review span | 2600 | 1000 | 800 |
| Damage shrinkage allowance (0.2%, rounded down) | 5 | 2 | 1 |
| Allowance after the cap of 4 | 4 | 2 | 1 |
| Less compliance holdback of 1 | 4 | 12 | 0 (below zero) |
| Cap: approval limit 8 plus uplift 0 | 8 | 8 | 8 |
| **Units approved** | **4** | **8** | **0** |

Case A works as 9 less 4 less 1, which is 4; Case B as 15 less 2 less 1, which is 12, held to 8.
